title: Hypertension follow-up: Uzbek with Russian medical words, dose increase plus a new drug

segments.speaker: doctor
segments.text: Assalomu alaykum, kiring, o'tiring. Xo'sh, nima bezovta qilyapti?

segments.speaker: patient
segments.text: Vaalaykum assalom, doktor. Oxirgi ikki haftadan beri boshim og'riyapti, ayniqsa ertalab, ensa qismida. Ba'zan ko'z oldim qorong'ilashadi.

segments.speaker: patient
segments.text: Ha, tonometr bor. Ertalab 160 ga 100 gacha chiqyapti, kechqurun 150 ga 90 atrofida.

segments.speaker: patient
segments.text: Amlodipin 5 milligramm, kuniga bir marta, olti oydan beri ichyapman.

segments.speaker: doctor
segments.text: Oilada yurak kasalligi, qand kasalligi bormi?

segments.speaker: patient
segments.text: Otamda gipertoniya bor edi, insult bo'lgan.

segments.speaker: doctor
segments.text: Hozir bosimingizni o'lchadim, 165 ga 100. Puls 82, ritmik. Yurak tonlari aniq, shovqin yo'q. O'pkada vezikulyar nafas, xirillash yo'q. Oyoqlarda shish yo'q.

segments.speaker: doctor
segments.text: Demak, tashxis: arterial gipertenziya, ikkinchi daraja. Davolashni kuchaytiramiz. Amlodipinni 10 milligrammga oshiramiz, kuniga bir marta ertalab. Qo'shimcha lizinopril 10 milligramm, kuniga bir marta.

segments.speaker: doctor
segments.text: Analizlar topshirasiz: obshiy analiz krovi, biokhimiya, kreatinin, kaliy, glyukoza. Plyus EKG qilib keling.

segments.speaker: doctor
segments.text: Tuzni kamaytiring, kuniga besh grammdan oshmasin. Har kuni ertalab va kechqurun bosimni o'lchab, daftarga yozib boring.

segments.speaker: doctor
segments.text: Ikki haftadan keyin natijalar bilan qayta keling.

facts.fact: Headache for 2 weeks, mainly in the morning, occipital; sometimes darkening of vision
Home blood pressure up to 160/100 in the morning, about 150/90 in the evening
Has been taking amlodipine 5 mg once daily for 6 months
Family history: father had hypertension and a stroke
Exam: BP 165/100, pulse 82 regular, clear heart sounds without murmurs, vesicular breathing without rales, no leg edema
Amlodipine increased to 10 mg once daily in the morning
Tests: complete blood count, biochemistry (creatinine, potassium, glucose) and ECG
Limit salt to 5 g per day
Measure BP every morning and evening and keep a diary
Follow-up in 2 weeks with test results
